docs_page_not_found_desc: This page does not exist or has been removed.
no_account_hero_body: Create a Klai account deliberately or choose another account to sign in.
no_account_body: We do not know this account at Klai yet. Create an account or sign in with another account.
join_request_body: Your email domain is not linked to any workspace. You can submit a request to join. An admin will review your request.
join_request_success: Your request has been submitted. You will receive an email when an admin has reviewed it.
select_workspace_body: Your account is linked to multiple workspaces. Select which one to open.
select_workspace_session_expired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
admin_shared_wizard_details_intro: Give this integration a name so you can find it back later.
admin_api_keys_wizard_kb_access_intro_ap: Select which knowledge bases this integration can use. "Write" is only available when "Add knowledge" is enabled.
admin_widgets_wizard_kb_access_intro_wid: Select which knowledge bases the agent can query. Agents never have write access.
admin_api_keys_wizard_rate_limit_intro: Maximum requests per minute for this integration. Keep this conservative to protect your usage budget.
admin_shared_wizard_error_name_too_short: Name must be at least 3 characters
admin_shared_wizard_error_no_kb_selected: Select at least one knowledge base
admin_widgets_wizard_error_invalid_origi: One or more website addresses are invalid
admin_widgets_widget_title_help: Shown in the chat header. For example: 'Klai Help' or 'Chat with support'.
admin_widgets_widget_welcome_help: The first message visitors see when they open the chat. Keep it short and inviting.
admin_widgets_widget_welcome_placeholder: Hi! How can I help you today?
admin_widgets_widget_system_prompt_help: Optional private base prompt for how this agent should answer. These instructions are sent to the model, but not exposed in the embed config.
admin_widgets_widget_system_prompt_place: Answer in the organisation's voice: direct, concise, and evidence-led. Start with the answer. Do not use hype, emoji, or closing pleasantries. If the knowledge base does not say it, say so plainly.
admin_widgets_widget_origins_help: Optional. By default the agent loads on any site that embeds the script. To restrict it to specific domains, list them here - one per line, starting with https:// (for example: https://mybusiness.com). This prevents others from copying your snippet and using the agent on their own site.
admin_widgets_allow_any_origin_warning: Conversations from any website will be attributed to this widget - only enable for public chatbots.
admin_widgets_wizard_embed_preview_help: After you create the integration, you'll get a unique agent ID. Paste the final snippet into any HTML page on an allowed origin.
admin_widgets_wizard_embed_intro: Install the agent on your website. Only the origins you list below are allowed to load it.
admin_widgets_integrations_intro: Connect {name} to an existing support tool so human agents can take over in realtime.
admin_widgets_integrations_status_summar: Ready for realtime handoff to HubSpot Help Desk.
The HubSpot connection is off. Visitors stay in Klai.
Not active yet. Connect HubSpot to test human-agent handoff.
The server is missing HubSpot OAuth configuration.
The last HubSpot action failed. Rebuild the connection or connect again.
admin_widgets_integrations_hubspot_descr: Route conversations to HubSpot Help Desk when a visitor needs a human agent. HubSpot remains the agent workspace; Klai remains the visitor webchat.
admin_widgets_integrations_not_configure: HubSpot OAuth configuration is missing on the server. Set the HubSpot client ID, client secret, and refresh token in the portal-api environment to use management actions.
admin_instructions_page_subtitle: Manage organization-wide instructions added to every chat conversation.
admin_instructions_empty_description: Create the first organization instruction to give everyone in your org access to consistent instructions.
admin_section_api_keys_description: Manage developer API keys for server-to-server integration.
admin_section_widgets_description: Put an AI agent on your website or share it via a link.
admin_api_keys_subtitle: Give applications access to Klai with an API key.
admin_api_keys_intro_body: Each API key has its own permissions and knowledge-base access.
admin_api_keys_intro_limits: Use API keys for integrations that chat with knowledge bases, send feedback, or add knowledge under explicit limits. Delete a key once an application no longer needs it.
admin_api_keys_empty_description: Create your first API key to integrate Klai into your application.
admin_api_keys_rotate_section_descriptio: Create a replacement key with the same permissions, knowledge-base access, and rate limit. The current key remains valid until you delete it.
admin_api_keys_rotate_pending_descriptio: A replacement key has already been created for this key. Update your applications, then delete this old key.
admin_api_keys_rotated_from_notice: This key was created as a replacement during rotation.
admin_api_keys_delete_section_descriptio: Permanently delete this API key. Anyone using it will get a 401 error on their next request. This cannot be undone.
admin_widgets_empty_description: Create your first agent to embed Klai on your website.
admin_widgets_delete_section_description: Permanently delete this agent. It will stop working immediately on every site where the embed snippet is installed. This cannot be undone.
admin_widgets_wizard_appearance_intro: Customise how the agent looks and feels to visitors. Title and welcome message appear in the chat; colour variables override the defaults.
chatbar_mode_narrow_tooltip_on: On: model answers strictly from the knowledge base. Click to disable.
chatbar_mode_narrow_tooltip_off: Off: model uses the knowledge base as context plus its general knowledge. Click for strict mode (KB only).
chatbar_mode_narrow_description: Model answers strictly from the knowledge base. If the answer is not in the sources, it will say so.
chatbar_mode_broad_description: Model uses the knowledge base as context and may complement with its general knowledge.
rules_empty_description: Add rules to control what topics, content, and data are allowed in AI conversations.
instructions_page_subtitle: Ways of working you turn on per chat.
instructions_intro_body: An instruction is a piece of text you turn on before a chat. Klai uses it as the starting point, so you don't have to type the same setup every time. You also use it for fixed output: a template Klai pours every answer into.
instructions_intro_example_1: customer-support replies with a fixed tone and clear escalation rules,
instructions_intro_example_2: or a sales follow-up after a demo that opens with the agreed next step.
instructions_intro_invoke: Turn one on from the Instructions button at the bottom of the chat. You can have several active at once.
instructions_empty_description: Instructions inject standard text into conversations where you turn them on, so you don't have to repeat yourself.
instructions_form_subtitle: Text added when you turn this instruction on in a chat.
instructions_form_prompt_placeholder: Apply this style. Answer in the user's language...
instructions_form_scope_org_disabled_too: Only administrators may create organization instructions
instructions_form_error_org_admin_only: Only administrators may create organization instructions
instructions_form_error_prompt_too_long: Instruction may be at most 8000 characters
instructions_form_error_slug_conflict: An instruction with this name already exists in this organization
instructions_form_error_generic: Something went wrong while saving. Please try again.
admin_settings_auto_accept_hint_on: Users from your domain can join immediately.
admin_settings_auto_accept_hint_off: Users from your domain request access first.
admin_users_confirm_leave_description: You will lose access to this workspace. If you are the last admin, you must promote another admin first.
danger_zone_subtitle: Permanent actions that cannot be undone.
danger_zone_delete_card_description: Permanently deletes the workspace and all associated data. This action cannot be reversed.
delete_org_modal_item_members: All team members (will be logged out)
delete_org_modal_item_billing: Invoice history remains available in Moneybird
delete_org_modal_error_conflict: The workspace is already being deleted
deprovisioning_status_timeout: This is taking longer than expected. Please contact support.
tenant_deleted_body: The workspace has been permanently deleted. All data has been erased.
profile_personal_description: Full chat features. Manage personal knowledge: upload documents, add web links, and run inquiries on up to 5 of your own knowledge bases.
profile_company_description: Everything in Personal chat, plus inquire on and contribute to company knowledge: read every team knowledge base and add documents or links through the chat.
profile_kb_manager_description: Everything in Company chat, plus manage company knowledge: connect Notion, Google Drive, M365, Confluence, GitHub and more, with member management, taxonomy, and gap detection.
profile_group_manager_description: Everything in Knowledge manager, plus manage groups and access: decide who's in which group and which knowledge bases they can use. No user invitations, billing, or settings.
profile_admin_description: Everything in Group manager, plus organisation administration: users, billing, settings, domains, integrations, API keys, and templates.
role_guard_description: This section requires the {minRole} role or higher.
admin_settings_addons_description: Enable or disable optional features for your organisation.
admin_settings_addon_docs: Docs: publish knowledge bases as a documentation site
connector_type_locked_tooltip: External connectors are available from the Knowledge manager role and up.
profile_picker_description: Select the role for this user on the five-rung profile ladder.
profile_picker_self_edit_hint: You cannot change your own profile.
admin_users_error_change_profile_min_adm: Cannot change profile: this is the last admin. Promote another user first.
admin_profiles_subtitle: Profiles decide what someone can do in Klai.
admin_profiles_intro_body: Profiles are an ascending ladder: from personal chat to full administration.
admin_profiles_intro_access: A higher profile also gets the rights from the profiles below it. Use groups for knowledge-base access; use profiles for product access and admin rights.
admin_profiles_drill_in_empty: No members in this profile yet.
integrations_subtitle: Apps that have access to your Klai knowledge base.
integrations_empty_description: Add Klai as a custom connector in Claude Desktop, Cursor, or ChatGPT with this URL:
integrations_empty_hint: You'll be redirected here to approve the connection.
admin_settings_telemetry_description: Choose how much query data Klai keeps.
admin_settings_telemetry_off_hint: No query data. Limits quality monitoring and incident support.
admin_settings_telemetry_shadow_hint: Keeps anonymous signals for 7 days. No literal questions.
admin_settings_telemetry_full_hint: Keeps literal questions for 7 days. Use only during active debugging.
admin_settings_telemetry_help: Shadow keeps anonymous signals for 7 days, without literal questions. Full also keeps literal questions for 7 days and is only meant for active debugging. Read more in our
admin_settings_telemetry_disabled_for_no: Only organisation admins can change this setting.
kb_sources_content_empty_connector: No items in this source yet.
kb_sources_content_no_preview: No text preview available - open the source in the editor to view its content.
kb_sources_empty_subtitle: Add files, links or connectors to bring knowledge into this collection.
admin_section_mcps_description: Connect Model Context Protocol servers to your workspace.
admin_settings_extensions_description_te: These are the features enabled for your workspace.
admin_settings_extensions_description_pl: Turn tenant features on or off. Only Klai can change this.
admin_settings_extensions_managed_by_kla: Want to turn something on or off? Contact Klai.
admin_extension_partner_api_description: Give integrations scoped access to chat, feedback and knowledge bases.
admin_extension_widgets_description: Create website or share-link agents that answer from selected knowledge bases.
admin_extension_custom_mcps_description: Add MCP servers so Klai can call extra tools for this workspace.
admin_extension_scribe_description: Record audio, upload files or send a meeting bot, then keep the transcript.
admin_extension_docs_description: Write and manage pages in knowledge bases, with access per page.
admin_widgets_widget_template_help: Pick an existing template to fill the base prompt quickly. You can still edit afterwards.
admin_widgets_widget_starters_help: Shown as clickable chips on the empty state. Max 6, one per line.
admin_widgets_widget_starters_placeholde:
What are your opening hours?
What products are available?
How do I get in touch?
admin_widgets_widget_hide_disclaimer_hel: White-label: hides the "AI answers can contain mistakes…" footer.
widget_ai_disclaimer: AI answers can contain mistakes. Always verify important information at the source.
widget_chat_default_empty_state: Ask your question and I will help you.
widget_chat_meta_sources_one: Answer based on 1 source from the knowledge base.
widget_chat_meta_sources_many: Answer based on {count} sources from the knowledge base.
admin_widgets_details_role_scope_help: Describe the domain and tasks. Off-topic questions are politely declined. The more specific, the better.
admin_widgets_brand_color_help: Accent color of your agent (buttons, hover states).
admin_widgets_welcome_help: The first message users see when they open the chat.
admin_widgets_show_sources_help: Show users the source documents below each answer.
admin_widgets_show_meta_help: Show users how the answer was assembled.
admin_widgets_collect_user_info_help: Capture name and email for follow-up.
admin_widgets_page_context_help: Sends the URL, title, and a short visible page excerpt. The AI only uses this when the question is clearly about the current page.
admin_widgets_subtitle: An agent answers your visitors' questions from your knowledge bases, and always cites the source. You decide which knowledge, template, and styling it uses.
admin_widgets_role_scope_placeholder: e.g. Answers questions about opening hours, pricing, and deliveries for Klai. Send off-topic questions to support@getklai.com.
admin_widgets_share_link_help: Anyone with this link can chat with the connected knowledge bases.
platform_description: Manage users, organizations, and bots across all tenants. Only visible to Klai staff.
platform_new_tenant_description: Creates a new organization with an initial admin owner. The owner receives an activation email to set a password. Provisioning for chat and knowledge starts automatically in the background.
platform_subdomains_section_tooling_desc: Internal team tooling — Vault, Grafana, CRM, etc.
platform_subdomains_section_tenants_desc: Per-tenant portal subdomains, sourced from portal_orgs.
platform_subdomains_load_error: Could not load the subdomain list.
platform_messages_compose_description: Send a direct in-app message to {recipient}.
platform_messages_send_unavailable: Sending messages is not available yet. Wait for the backend deploy to finish, then try again.
platform_danger_description: Delete the entire tenant: all users, bots, knowledge bases, containers, and the Zitadel organization are permanently cleaned up. This cannot be undone.
platform_user_errors_description: Frontend crashes and exceptions that users hit in the browser, collected in GlitchTip.
platform_full_service_status_description: Realtime monitoring for all Klai services (retrieval, ingest, connector, scribe, mailer, chat) runs in Uptime Kuma.
platform_feedback_closed_hidden_hint: Closed items are hidden from active feedback by default.
platform_feedback_read_report_title: Read the report and understand context
platform_feedback_dismiss_help: Use dismiss only when this report is not a product, bug, or support signal.
platform_feedback_triage_question: What do you want to do with this feedback?
platform_feedback_choice_product: Link to or create an item
platform_feedback_choice_product_hint: A bug, feature or improvement for the product
platform_feedback_choice_support_hint: A support question, not a product change
platform_feedback_product_step_title: Link to an existing item — or create a new one
platform_feedback_advice_match: Klai thinks: this looks like an existing item ({title}).
platform_feedback_advice_new: Klai thinks: no existing item found — likely new.
platform_feedback_support_help: Support means no product or open item is created; the report is handled as a customer question or support signal.
platform_feedback_smart_search_label: Smart search term for open items
platform_feedback_ai_matches_help: AI already found possible matches above. Use search only if you want to link another item.
platform_feedback_delete_submission_desc: The report will be deleted and linked item signals will be updated.
platform_feedback_no_linked_feedback_war: No linked feedback. Link evidence from triage before asking an agent to fix this item.
platform_feedback_delete_item_descriptio: The item will be deleted and linked feedback will be moved back to new.
platform_feedback_copy_debug_description: Copy a compact prompt with item data, customer reports, and context so an agent can work on the bug immediately.
platform_feedback_resolve_description: Close this item and send linked reporters an update in their account.
platform_feedback_resolve_feature_button: Mark as shipped and message user
platform_feedback_action_failed: Action failed. Try again or open the console for details.
platform_onboarding_description: Step-by-step guide for creating a customer tenant and checking that provisioning, chat, knowledge, templates, and invitations work.
platform_onboarding_prereq_admin: You need platform-admin access; the tenant creation button is only available there.
platform_onboarding_prereq_owner_email: You need the email address of the new tenant owner.
platform_onboarding_prereq_unique_email: The email address must not already exist as a user. If it does, clean up the old tenant or user first.
platform_onboarding_step_create_body: Go to platform admin and create a new tenant. Fill company name, owner email, first name, and last name. Provisioning starts automatically for the organization, knowledge bases, chat environment, AI team, and subdomain route.
platform_onboarding_step_create_expect: Expected: the status moves to ready within roughly 10 to 30 seconds and the owner receives exactly one activation email.
platform_onboarding_step_owner_body: The owner opens the activation email, chooses a password of at least 12 characters with one symbol, and logs in to the new tenant.
platform_onboarding_step_owner_expect: Expected: the owner enters the portal without a separate confirmation email and sees the first tenant environment.
platform_onboarding_step_chat_body: Open the Chat tab in the tenant, choose the right knowledge sources, and ask a simple question the new organization can answer.
platform_onboarding_step_chat_expect: Expected: chat answers without SSO or provisioning errors and uses the tenant context.
platform_onboarding_step_knowledge_body: Open Knowledge, choose a collection, and add a file, URL, text source, or external connector.
platform_onboarding_step_knowledge_expec: Expected: sources are processed to synced and show their real name.
platform_onboarding_step_instructions_bo: Open Instructions and check whether existing instructions are visible, or create a first instruction.
platform_onboarding_step_instructions_ex: Expected: instructions are available in chat configuration once active.
platform_onboarding_step_invite_body: Invite additional users from the tenant or from the platform organization detail page and choose the right role.
platform_onboarding_step_invite_expect: Expected: every invitee receives one activation email and appears in the user list afterwards.
klai_assistant_option_question_desc: Help with Klai, settings and workflows.
klai_assistant_option_feedback_desc: Share an idea, request or improvement.
klai_assistant_option_problem_desc: Tell us what is not working well.
klai_assistant_question_hero_desc: Ask a question about Klai. We automatically include the current page as context.
klai_assistant_question_success_desc: We saved your question with the right Klai context.
klai_assistant_feedback_label: What would you like to share?
klai_assistant_feedback_placeholder: Describe your idea, request or improvement...
klai_assistant_feedback_success_desc: Thank you. We will include your feedback in product triage.
klai_assistant_problem_placeholder: Describe what you tried, what happened and what you expected...
klai_assistant_problem_success_desc: We saved your report with page and browser context.
klai_assistant_disclaimer: AI answers can contain mistakes. Always verify important information at the source.
